action: Locally restore the darker lower façade components and make the street-level glazing read as transparent frontage. Preserve the corrected pale projecting outer framing, existing floor/bay divisions, repaired recesses and retained terrace assemblies. This finding does not authorize expanding the pending balcony-only execution scope.</issue>
<keep>Corrected pale outward-facing framing finish on the left block and connector.
Visible side and soffit returns in the repaired source-facing tower recesses.
Connected low-wing terrace surfaces, perimeter edges and recessed outdoor bays shown in CURRENT 12.</keep>
